## ShipFast Hackathon Highlights ✨

𝗪𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗙𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲'𝘀 𝘁𝗼𝗽 𝗔𝗜 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝗽𝗶𝗰 𝗵𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻. 𝗪𝗲 𝗱𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗱 ! 🔥🚀

## Winning projects

### 🥇𝟭𝘀𝘁 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗲: 𝗔𝘃𝗼𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 

AvoPoint is a web application that automates the process of disputing traffic tickets using OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and AI to process documents and automatically generate dispute letters.

by Romain Batlle, Morgane CHANE, Baptiste CRUVELLIER, Yoann LEROUGE 👏

### 🥈𝟮𝗻𝗱 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗲: 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗨𝗻𝗹𝗼𝘃𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝘀 

A web interface for AI-powered video generation using script inputs, mood boards, and base images.

by Matteo Lippi, Abhinav Singh, Daniel Yuan 👏

### 🥉𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗲: 𝗔𝗸𝗿𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗮 

Beat procrastination and akrasia with financial accountability ! 

by Samir Fernando Florido Poka, Miguel Torrez, Cyriaque Bouquin-Martin 👏


Finalists : ⭐ 𝗦𝘆𝗻𝗮𝗽𝘀 & 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘆𝗻𝗰 ⭐
